title: 日本ダービーの後に・散華の歓び

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And T.M. Opera O finishes! She couldn't prevail against her sworn rival, Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas! How could this be?! Defeated by my nemesis after stoking out her true potential…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But I am yet radiant in tragedy! Am I not, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That was merely part of the script. In no way whatsoever do I feel tragic! I'm sure you understand that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course this isn't enough to faze T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, well, Ayabe! I could hardly believe that was you running.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Though I lost, your splendid display made for a great performance. What was your motivation?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was… what you told me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: After the Satsuki Sho, you told me to face the troubles within myself …

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's how I managed to concentrate on my running. And here is the result.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Now I know… I can handle the burden. I can face my destiny.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that was it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How like me. Inadvertently enlightening others through casual everyday conversation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How about it, Ayabe? In the very beginning, you were reticent about playing the part of my rival.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But now that you've lived it, are you not filled with satisfaction from the residuals of my spotlight?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sure. I guess you could say it that way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can, as I have! You should puff out your chest and declare to the world your newfound joy!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O is amazing…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe really hated her… But now she's laughing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But listen well! The opening bars have only just been sung.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With the first act of our classic year coming to a close this spring, the main show is now set to start!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: For what lies ahead of us are the senior year races.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, Ayabe? With experience playing my rival under your belt, would you join my side to take on the generation of yore?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Our sights will be set…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: On the Arima Kinen at this year's end! Will you not join me in ringing the bell to start this generational change?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Derby just ended, but T.M. Opera O is already fired up for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll… pass.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How could this be? It's unlike you to be reluctant. You must tell me why!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have two… One, that I'm not good enough to beat them yet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And the other…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Keeping up with your antics is… exhausting. I can't take it around the clock like this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A-Ayabe?! Do not give up so easily! You will adapt, and soon enough this will all be second nature!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come back, Ayabe! Fly into my bosom! Embrace me wholeheartedly! …Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega's face turns bright red, and she books it straight out of here. It must've been too awkward for her to handle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, shyness on that scale could be an issue.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Such are her ways. She will surely come around in time.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with the spring Classic finished, T.M. Opera O charges forward with newly fortified strength toward the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nghhh… Opera O's rival…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Back then, if I had just done something…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My worthy adversary is you, Doto, the surprise villain! Take my hand and rise onto the stage! Come, come!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I had taken her hand then, by now, I would be…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… Urghh…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wish I were stronger… So maybe someday…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I could impress even Opera O!
